name: MENT 5672
title: Leading Yourself
description: Human resources professionals and managers who understand their own management skills and style are more effective in achieving their personal and professional goals.  To help build student self-­awareness, the class introduces and employs assessment instruments commonly utilized by business leaders.  Students learn to give and receive feedback, build skills inventories and develop personal growth and career development plans, goals and strategies.
requirement_description: MENT 5138 or 5183; open to MBA students, others with permission.
